source: Netty's direct-memory limit (io.netty.maxDirectMemory) on a request body, probed on the 9.2.0 oracle: the body is read in 64 KiB buffers that the aggregator keeps until the request is whole. 6.2 MB passed and 7 MB failed every time; 6.4-6.8 MB came out either way, so the scenario keeps clear of the band.

steps.note: a 4 MB body against an 8 MiB limit is read in full

mask.reason: the oracle sits behind Docker's network, an address of its own
what the pool holds at the failure depends on the sizes the socket's reads came in
the client's address as the oracle sees it (Docker's gateway)
